title: Yellowed Russian Chicken Kebabs
description: Tangy and crunchy Russian dish featuring malai and tandoor flavors, perfect for a nostalgic meal, this recipe is low in sodium and easy to make on a lazy susan spinner.
instructions: Preheat the tandoor or oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together malai, lemon juice, olive oil, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken breast to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Thread the marinated chicken, onion, and bell pepper onto skewers.
Place the skewers on the lazy susan spinner and cook for 20 minutes, turning occasionally.
Increase the heat to 450 degrees Fahrenheit and cook for an additional 5 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Serve the kebabs hot, garnished with fresh parsley or dill.
Let the kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving.
